005package org.wpilib.util.struct;
006
007/** Known data types for raw struct dynamic fields (see StructFieldDescriptor). */
008public enum StructFieldType {
009  /** bool. */
010  BOOL("bool", false, false, 1),
011  /** char. */
012  CHAR("char", false, false, 1),
013  /** int8. */
014  INT8("int8", true, false, 1),
015  /** int16. */
016  INT16("int16", true, false, 2),
017  /** int32. */
018  INT32("int32", true, false, 4),
019  /** int64. */
020  INT64("int64", true, false, 8),
021  /** uint8. */
022  UINT8("uint8", false, true, 1),
023  /** uint16. */
024  UINT16("uint16", false, true, 2),
025  /** uint32. */
026  UINT32("uint32", false, true, 4),
027  /** uint64. */
028  UINT64("uint64", false, true, 8),
029  /** float. */
030  FLOAT("float", false, false, 4),
031  /** double. */
032  DOUBLE("double", false, false, 8),
033  /** struct. */
034  STRUCT("struct", false, false, 0);
035
036  /** The name of the data type. */
037  public final String name;
038
039  /** Indicates if the data type is a signed integer. */
040  public final boolean isInt;
041
042  /** Indicates if the data type is an unsigned integer. */
043  public final boolean isUint;
044
045  /** The size (in bytes) of the data type. */
046  public final int size;
047
048  StructFieldType(String name, boolean isInt, boolean isUint, int size) {
049    this.name = name;
050    this.isInt = isInt;
051    this.isUint = isUint;
052    this.size = size;
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public String toString() {
057    return name;
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Get field type from string.
062   *
063   * @param str string
064   * @return field type
065   */
066  public static StructFieldType fromString(String str) {
067    for (StructFieldType type : StructFieldType.values()) {
068      if (type.name.equals(str)) {
069        return type;
070      }
071    }
072    if ("float32".equals(str)) {
073      return FLOAT;
074    } else if ("float64".equals(str)) {
075      return DOUBLE;
076    } else {
077      return STRUCT;
078    }
079  }
080}
